title: Turkey Tikka with Green Lentils and Cucumber Raita
blurb: Spiced turkey escalopes served with herbed green lentils and a cooling cucumber and cottage cheese raita.
steps: Peel and grate the ginger and garlic, then mix in a bowl with the yoghurt, garam masala, ground cumin, ground coriander and a pinch of salt. Add the turkey escalopes and turn to coat, then leave to marinate for 20 minutes.
Rinse the lentils and place in a saucepan with the vegetable stock. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Meanwhile, peel and dice the cucumber into small pieces. Mix with the cottage cheese and half the chopped parsley, then squeeze over half the lemon juice and season with salt.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Shake excess marinade from the turkey and cook for 4 to 5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Stir the remaining parsley through the cooked lentils and squeeze over the remaining lemon juice. Serve the turkey alongside the lentils with the cucumber raita spooned over.
